lines.en: One flick of the tail, past the coral branch.
Stay with the school; do not fall behind.
The water is warm, and the way is short.
I slip in and out of the rock crevices.
Careful, there is a big fish ahead.

lines.zh: 一摆一摆，像片会动的叶子。
lines.en: Wiggling along like a moving leaf.

lines.zh: 这条沟我每天都游三遍。
lines.en: I swim this trench three times a day.
Behind the coral fan is safer.

lines.zh: 阳光照到水底，路看得清。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches the bottom; the way is clear.
I swim slowly, but my direction is right.
The whole school turns the same way.
The warm shallows are not deep; no need to fear.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，溅起细小水花。
lines.en: A tail flick throws up tiny ripples.
Seagrass ahead; swim around it.

lines.zh: 我拐进红树林的根缝里。
lines.en: I slip between the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 一群同类从侧面游过，我跟上去。
lines.en: A school passes on my flank, and I join it.
My colors are brightest today.

lines.zh: 三千多种模样，我是哪一种？
lines.en: Three thousand shapes; which one am I?
A bubble slips out past my gills.
I pause among the seagrass.
That fish keeps looking at me.
This coral patch is my territory.

lines.zh: 嘴巴一张一合，没什么可说。
lines.en: Mouth opens and closes; nothing to say.
I count the patches of light.
The water is just right; do not change.
Who stirred up the sand?
I hide inside a clump of red coral.
No dolphins passed by today.
My fins are tired; I will rest.
The quiet seabed is the most comfortable.

lines.zh: 好大一张脸，贴到水上了。
lines.en: Such a big face, pressed to the water.

lines.zh: 你要抓我吗？我有桶的味道。
lines.en: Are you catching me? I smell a bucket.

lines.zh: 你的手比我整条鱼还大。
lines.en: Your hand is bigger than my whole body.
I am so small; am I worth staring at?
Did you notice my patterns?
Do not tap the bucket; my ears are sharp.

lines.zh: 你的影子把阳光挡住了。
lines.en: Your shadow is blocking my sunlight.
I will back up a little into the coral.

lines.zh: 你是来喂食还是来捞鱼？
lines.en: Are you here to feed or to scoop?

lines.zh: 我眨不了眼，只能看着你。
lines.en: I cannot blink, so I just watch you.

lines.zh: 珊瑚枝刮掉我一片橙鳞。
lines.en: A coral branch scraped off one of my orange scales.
Do not poke; I am fragile.
The water is reddening; swim away.
It hurts so much I spin in circles.
Who touched me? I am so small.
There is a tear in my fin.
I duck into the coral to catch my breath.
I will remember that one for a long time.
The school scattered, leaving me alone.
My patterns got scuffed.
Is that food? It smells like it.

lines.zh: 水里飘着碎屑，我追过去。
lines.en: Flakes drift in the water; I chase them.
Algae? That is my favorite.
Do not scatter too much; my belly is tiny.

lines.zh: 一丁点就够我高兴半天。
lines.en: A tiny crumb keeps me happy for hours.
That thing is moving; it must be edible.
I get there before my schoolmates.
What are you holding in your hand?
The taste drifts down the current.
Scatter a little more, just a little.
Bumped the coral; my head is spinning.
You are too hasty; give me room.

lines.zh: 一群体挤在一起，谁都动不了。
lines.en: The school is packed; nobody can move.
My fin is pinned.

lines.zh: 别顶我，我方向感本来就差。
lines.en: Stop nudging; my sense of direction is poor already.

lines.zh: 水花一散，我们撞成一团。
lines.en: The water swirls and we crash together.

lines.zh: 你那么大，撞我一下很疼。
lines.en: You are huge; one bump hurts.
Go around; the coral will break.
Squeeze together; it is warmer.

lines.zh: 撞完各自游开，装作没事。
lines.en: We bump, swim apart, and pretend nothing happened.
Your patterns go well with mine.

lines.zh: 转一圈，让我看看你的鳍。
lines.en: Turn around and show me your fins.

lines.zh: 我们一起护着这片珊瑚。
lines.en: Let us guard this coral together.

lines.zh: 水暖的时候，就该成对了。
lines.en: When the water warms, it is time to pair.
Easy; swim with me first.
Your orange is a shade brighter than mine.
Two fish circle the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会有哪种花纹？
lines.en: Which pattern will our young carry?
This shallow flat has room for us both.

lines.zh: 靠近些，水流会替我们说话。
lines.en: Come closer; the current will speak for us.
I cannot hold things; my mouth is too small.

lines.zh: 那颗小石子，让它沉底吧。
lines.en: Let that pebble sink.
Something fell into the water?

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了碰，又滑走了。
lines.en: I nudge it with my mouth; it slips away.
That is not food; it is a scrap of iron.
I only pick up what I can eat.
Once it sinks into the sand, it is lost.
The others are grabbing; I join in.
Too small; I can barely hold it.

lines.zh: 让它留着，也许能孵出什么。
lines.en: Leave it; maybe something will hatch.
That big fish is heading this way.
That shadow is too big to be one of us.
I can see its teeth.
Everyone scatter; dive into the coral.
It is eyeing our whole school.
I must shoo the little ones away first.
The water trembles; it is coming.
That tentacle does not belong to a fish.
My colors are too bright to hide.
Hide deeper; do not look back.
I watch it; it watches me.
Keep your distance; do not turn away.
When it moves, I move.
The coral gap is right beside me.
My heartbeat is faster than my fins.
Do not blink; it waits for me to relax.
Our school circles around it.

lines.zh: 它的嘴一张一合，在算什么。
lines.en: Its mouth opens and closes, calculating.
I rise a little to see it clearly.

lines.zh: 就这么僵着，谁先动谁输。
lines.en: We freeze; whoever moves first loses.
I nipped its fin once.
These teeth barely tickle.
I ram it once; that counts as a strike.
It is too big to bite.

lines.zh: 一群鱼一起啄，也很烦人。
lines.en: A whole school pecking is quite annoying.
I pecked near its eye.
My tail lashes like a tiny whip.
It backed off half a step; I won.
My jaw aches and I have not broken through.
Do not underestimate a small fish's teeth.

lines.zh: 水是暖的，我在这里出生。
lines.en: The water is warm; I was born here.

lines.zh: 三千种花纹，我抽到这一种。
lines.en: Three thousand patterns, and I drew this one.

lines.zh: 珊瑚丛里多了一尾小鱼。
lines.en: One more small fish in the coral.
I slip out from between the seagrass.

lines.zh: 这里的水深刚好，五十格上下。
lines.en: The depth is just right, around fifty blocks.

lines.zh: 一群同伴已经在等我了。
lines.en: A school is already waiting for me.

lines.zh: 红树林的根下有我的位置。
lines.en: There is a place for me under the mangrove roots.
The first mouthful of water is a bit salty.
I flick my tail and learn the way.

lines.zh: 又一个花纹，世界又多一种颜色。
lines.en: One more pattern; the world gains another color.

lines.zh: 水在发烫，我的鳍缩起来。
lines.en: The water is scalding; my fins curl.
Dropped on the sand, I cannot even flop.
Out of water, I dry out and die.
One blast and the whole coral shatters.
Something shot through the water and grazed me.
A flash, and my colors dimmed.
Nothing to eat; my belly is empty.
Lightning hit the water; everything tingles.
No water left; I flail in the air.
